title: Obsession
identity_notes: Psychological mystery/drama anthology centered on destructive fixations and personal conflict. Specialist references describe 78 programs produced for the 1950-1952 WBBM/MacGregor run. The frozen GRH container preserves 30 drama recordings plus one short synopsis/reference track, not a 31-episode historical run.

historical_context.title: AFRS and AFRTS rebroadcast preservation
historical_context.description: A substantial portion of the surviving GRH set is labeled or indexed as AFRS/AFRTS rebroadcast material, distinguishing transfer provenance from original WBBM identity.

historical_context.title: Partial survival of a 78-program run
historical_context.description: The documented run contains 78 programs; the frozen GRH container preserves 30 drama recordings plus a synopsis/reference object.

historical_context.title: Postwar psychological mystery anthology
historical_context.description: Obsession used self-contained psychological and mystery dramas built around fixation, conflict and destructive desire.

historical_context.title: WBBM Chicago and MacGregor syndication
historical_context.description: The series originated at WBBM/CBS Chicago and circulated through C. P. MacGregor syndication.
